candidates.version: No HAR Workshop 3128454510; Patch fixed 72af7af 1.5_1.6; Historical audited 2026-10-16

comparison.function: Generic Net Fisher and 52 medieval-categorized Defs from fixed GTF source; Historical adds 500 broad-epoch biographies.
comparison.historical_fit: Fishing roles overlap in name but European/broad-epoch contexts; no confirmed same Japan-specific water maintenance pair.
comparison.dependencies: Whole Mod contents and optional per-faction category patches change generation and load costs.
comparison.retention: Legitimate optional alternate diversity rather than mandatory replacement of AMJ core.
comparison.progression_balance: Importing all changes pool much more than four targeted biographies.
comparison.reuse: Reuse generation-category XML pattern only; never copy prose.
comparison.maintenance_license: Third-party authored content, original GTF XML publicly inspected, 1.7 current originals not fully confirmed.

decision.rationale: The existing AMJ 123 reviewed historical rewrites and generic medieval providers do not provide the targeted Japanese coastal processing and shared rural irrigation labor histories without broad third-party content, category overrides or unnecessary dependencies.
decision.independent_gap: Precisely four Japan-specific low-status shore- and water-caretaking childhood/adult biographies with balanced civilian skills, usable with vanilla and optionally MO, independent of a fishing or irrigation gameplay Mod.
